name: G. E. M. Anscombe
shortBio: Leading British analytic philosopher, student and literary executor of Ludwig Wittgenstein, who revitalized modern virtue ethics and the philosophy of action.
centralQuestion: How can moral philosophy be intelligible without an underlying divine lawgiver, unless grounded in human flourishing and teleological virtues?

keyWorks.title: Modern Moral Philosophy
keyWorks.description: Epoch-making article inaugurating contemporary virtue ethics through critique of utilitarianism and Kantian deontology.

keyWorks.title: Intention
keyWorks.description: Foundational monograph in modern action theory exploring intentional action, knowledge without observation, and practical reasoning.
